key_findings: Subimods has a partial shop.app presence — only OEM Subaru parts and Motul oils are indexed
None of the 5 aftermarket performance products (Fluidampr, COBB, PRL Motorsports) appear as Subimods listings on shop.app
Matching products from other sellers DO appear on shop.app — this is what H6 originally detected
The H6 finding 'products absent from Catalog API are present on shop.app' was checking the wrong thing (product title match, not seller identity)
When seller identity is checked, the two surfaces agree: Subimods' aftermarket performance catalog is not indexed on either surface
This is NOT a platform inconsistency — it is a consistent absence. Subimods may have opted out of Catalog syndication for aftermarket parts, or their feed may be filtered.
implications_for_u9: Set B (absent from Catalog API but present on shop.app under own merchant) CANNOT be assembled from Subimods. Need to find other merchants whose products are absent from Catalog but present on shop.app under their own listing.
